missing_evidence: Postgres server-side metrics: active/idle connections, max_connections, wait queue depth
Order service pool configuration and pool wait-time metrics
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502 checkout responses.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle attributes are client-reported; no server-side saturation data confirms exhaustion versus slow queries.

report.explanation: Traces across three correlated checkouts show inventory and payment succeeding, then postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable at pool size 5/idle 0, propagating to order 503 and gateway 502. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; server-side pool metrics still needed to confirm.
